name: RSI Eraser
summary: RSI Eraser is an Expert Advisor that trades mean reversion signals based on the RSI indicator reaching extreme overbought or oversold levels. It enters counter-trend positions when RSI exits extreme zones, expecting price to revert to the mean. The EA includes configurable RSI periods, extreme thresholds, and basic risk management parameters.
summary_zh: RSI Eraser是一个基于RSI指标极端超买超卖信号的均值回归交易EA。当RSI从极端区域退出时，它逆势开仓，预期价格将回归均值。该EA包含可配置的RSI周期、极端阈值和基本风险管理参数。
strategy_analysis: RSI Eraser的核心策略概念是均值回归，利用RSI指标识别市场极端状态。入场条件为：当RSI从超卖区（低于设定下限阈值）向上穿越时买入，当RSI从超买区（高于设定上限阈值）向下穿越时卖出，本质上是在市场极端时逆势入场。出场条件依赖可配置的止盈止损，同时可能包含RSI回归中性区域时的平仓逻辑。仓位管理方面，EA允许固定手数交易，部分版本可能支持基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于止损设置和单笔风险控制，但具体实现程度取决于参数配置的严谨性。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能面临连续逆势亏损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of RSI Eraser is mean reversion, using the RSI indicator to identify extreme market conditions. Entry conditions are: buy when RSI crosses upward from the oversold zone (below the configured lower threshold), and sell when RSI crosses downward from the overbought zone (above the configured upper threshold), essentially entering counter-trend positions at market extremes. Exit conditions rely on configurable take-profit and stop-loss levels, and may also include closing logic when RSI returns to neutral territory. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some implementations potentially offering dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management depends on stop-loss settings and per-trade risk control, though the rigor of implementation varies with parameter configuration. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but faces the risk of consecutive counter-trend losses during strong trending conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识号，防止与其他EA冲突

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，基于经典RSI超买超卖原理，易于理解和验证
均值回归思路在震荡行情中具有较高的胜率和稳定的收益潜力
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活调整RSI阈值和周期
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, based on the classic RSI overbought/oversold principle, making it easy to understand and verify
Mean reversion approach has high win rate and stable profit potential in ranging markets
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to flexibly adjust RSI thresholds and periods for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 纯逆势策略在强趋势行情中会频繁发出错误信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，无法区分震荡市和趋势市，容易在趋势行情中反复逆势入场
默认止损为0意味着可能不设止损，存在单笔交易无限亏损的极端风险
cons_en: Pure counter-trend strategy generates frequent false signals during strong trending markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks trend filter mechanism, unable to distinguish between ranging and trending markets, prone to repeated counter-trend entries during trends
Default stop-loss of 0 means no stop-loss may be set, creating extreme risk of unlimited loss on a single trade
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），仅在震荡行情中启用逆势交易信号
强制要求设置止损，并增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，以适应不同波动率环境
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX indicator) to enable counter-trend signals only in ranging markets
Mandate stop-loss settings and add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation to adapt to different volatility environments

risk_points: 默认止损为0，在不设止损的情况下单笔交易可能造成巨大亏损
缺乏趋势过滤和多重确认机制，强趋势行情中逆势交易风险极高
无新K线检查机制可能导致同一信号重复开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 means a single trade without stop-loss can cause catastrophic losses
Lacks trend filter and multi-confirmation mechanism, making counter-trend trading extremely risky during strong trends
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated position opening on the same signal

It enters counter-trend positions when RSI exits extreme zones, expecting price to revert to the mean. The EA includes configurable RSI periods, extreme thresholds, and basic risk management parameters.
